comparison.objective: Start a separating jacket zipper by fully seating its pin in the box, then zip it up.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable alignment, pin insertion, and slider pulling under tension.
comparison.success_condition: Pin fully seated and zipper closed; body and closure-length or damage rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Fine insertion with deformable fabric tests mating and sliding, not controlled impact fracture or loose metal-fragment recovery.
